skip: The saved article has about 230 words of substance, and the existing description already gives most of it (son of Vijayalaya, defeat of Aparajita c. 897, annexation of Tondaimandalam, succession of Parantaka I). What it adds would fill one paragraph: the Battle of Thirupurambiyam of 878 CE, where Aditya joined Aparajita and the Western Ganga king Prithvipati I against the Pandyan king Varagunavarman II; the submission of Prithvipati II; the conquest of Kongu Nadu, possibly with the support of the Chera ruler Sthanu Ravi; the repair of the highway Rajakesari Peruvazhi; and his death in 907 CE at Tondaimanarrur, where Parantaka I built a Shiva temple. The article says nothing of Aditya himself building temples, which the existing description states.
